abilities.name: Dawnfrost Darkstar

_curatorNotes: C4 bonus Spiritvessel Skull, re-homed 2026-09-15 from a `manual` damage effect on the C4 entry (which reached no surface). gcsim cons.go c4SkullCB is the AttackCBFunc on every Frostfall Storm hit: 8s ICD status, then a Cryo / Durability 25 / ICDTagNone attack at spiritVesselSkullHitmark (57f). Hosted on Itzpapa so the summon's liveness arms it; `filter.abilityName: 'Itzpapa'` narrows the stream to Frostfall Storm ticks (a summon tick's abilityName is its label), and a proc never hears its own output. icdGate 'none' = ICDTagNone. The +16 Nightsoul / +8 Energy halves are resource, not modelled.

abilities.caveat: Tick markers are shown across the full window, but in game they only start once Nightsoul reaches 50 and Opal Fire activates — so the early ticks are over-shown while points build up.
_curatorNotes: Skill spawns two follows-player summons: Itzpapa (combat emitter) at frame 18 and the Opal Shield at frame 37. Authoring as instant + summons[] (not stance) because Citlali's normals don't change in Nightsoul — there's no in-stance N variant to gate.

Itzpapa's Opal Fire state requires 50+ Nightsoul points to enter, drains 8 points/sec while active, and ends when points hit 0. Per the constitution (windows not gauges), the resource pool is not modelled; the flat 20s window approximates 'maximum possible Itzpapa activity.'

Frostfall Storm tick (P3): gcsim itzpapaInterval=59f (=0.983s), Cryo damage scaling 30.64% ATK at TalentLvl 10. Ticks render for the full Itzpapa window — see caveat for the over-render note. ↻ 2026-09-15: icdGate {timer 90, every 2} — gcsim tags the tick ICDTagCitlaliFrostfallStorm / ICDGroupCitlaliFrostfallStorm, reset 90f with sequence {1.0, 0.0} (pkg/core/attacks/icd_groups.dm.go), so every second tick applies; the 59f interval is under the 90f timer, so the counter never resets. ⚠️ The oracle never sees this stream (Nightsoul never reaches 50 in the isolated core), so no report would have proposed it. ↻ 2026-10-04 (ICD cap round): {timer 90} — FIRST ONLY. gcsim reads past a list's end as its LAST entry (0 here), so {1.0, 0.0} never applies a second hit in a window; and the counter DOES reset, 89f after the window's first hit. At the 59f interval both readings apply ticks 1, 3, 5…, so nothing on screen moves — the rule is what changed.

Opal Shield authored 2026-07-12 as a shield effect (onCast skill, target 'active' — gcsim shield.go addShield sets Tmpl.Target -1 = protects the on-field character; forms at frame 37 per QueueCharTask(c.addShield, 37), matching the Opal Shield summon spawnsAt). Absorption at TalentLvl 10: 1036.8% of Citlali's EM + 3050.92 flat (sidecar 'Shield DMG Absorption' 10th column '1036.8% Elemental Mastery+3051'; gcsim shieldEM[9]=10.368, shieldFlat[9]=3050.9182). Duration 20s (sidecar 'Shield Duration' row; gcsim Expires = c.Core.F + 20*60). The 250% Cryo DMG-absorption efficiency and the brief self-Cryo application on placement (skill.go ApplySelfInfusion Cryo) are not modelled — no per-element shield-efficiency primitive, same as the Diona/Kaeya notes. The Opal Shield summon lane is retained alongside the effect (mirrors Thoma's Blazing Barrier summon + shield-effect pairing).
C6 Teoiztac removes the Opal Fire end condition (always active) and unlocks Cifra of the Secret Law stacks; not modelled.

[A7] Nightsoul starts at 24 after the cast and builds toward the 50-point Opal Fire threshold via team-Cryo application and the A4 Frozen/Melt Nightsoul regen. Per the constitution (windows, not gauges) the Nightsoul resource pool is not modeled; the flat 20s window approximates maximum possible Itzpapa activity.

↻ 2026-08-14 — the stand-in summon is retired. "Opal Shield" was a zero-effect `summons[]` entry whose only jobs were to give this instant cast a 20s active window and to put a labelled bar on the chart. Both now have their own field: `activeDuration` on the ability and `label` on the shield Effect, which the shield lane renders. `summons[]` is back to meaning a thing left in the world. Bar geometry is unchanged apart from the spawn offset, which the shield window never had.
abilities.description:
Invoking secret pacts passed down by her tribe over the millennia, Citlali deploys an Opal Shield and calls forth "Obsidian Tzitzimitl: Itzpapa," a creature that is (reputedly) terrifying beyond compare, dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Cryo DMG.
The Opal Shield's DMG absorption scales based on Citlali's Elemental Mastery, and absorbs Cryo DMG with 250% efficiency. When it is deployed, it will cause Citlali to briefly be affected by Cryo.
After using this skill, Citlali gains 24 Nightsoul points and enters the Nightsoul's Blessing state.

Nightsoul's Blessing: Citlali
When Itzpapa leaves the field, Citlali exits the Nightsoul's Blessing state.

Itzpapa
·Itzpapa will follow the character.
·If Citlali has at least 50 Nightsoul points, Itzpapa enters the Opal Fire state and continuously consumes Nightsoul points to whip up a Frostfall Storm that follows the character and attacks opponents within its AoE, dealing Nightsoul-aligned Cryo DMG.
·When Citlali's Nightsoul points are fully depleted, Itzpapa's Opal Fire state also ends.

abilities.name: Edict of Entwined Splendor
_curatorNotes: Burst is instant: initial Ice Storm hit at frame 118 (gcsim iceStormHitmark), then up to 3 Spiritvessel Skulls explode at frame 210 (~3.5s after cast). Skulls aren't authored as summons because they're targeted at enemies (mobility 'follows enemy' isn't expressible) and their lifetime is just delayed-damage flavor.
Restores 24 Nightsoul + 3 per skull; not modelled (resource accounting).
abilities.description: Summons "allies" from the starry skies and the vast earth, hurling forth an ice storm to bombard the area in front and deal Nightsoul-aligned AoE Cryo DMG. This restores a set amount of Nightsoul points for Citlali, and also summons a Spiritvessel Skull near a maximum of 3 opponents within the AoE, with 1 Skull for each opponent. Spiritvessel Skulls explode after some time, dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Cryo DMG and restoring a set amount of Nightsoul points for Citlali.

notModeled.reason: The Rotation Planner doesn't track Nightsoul points, so the points this burst restores to Citlali aren't shown.

passives.name: Mamaloaco's Frigid Rain
_curatorNotes: Pyro + Hydro RES shred on Frozen/Melt while Itzpapa is on the field. Gated by state: duringSummon (Itzpapa is the canonical summon during Citlali's skill window). 8s ICD on the Nightsoul-regen half (16 points) is not modelled — pure resource.
passives.description: While Itzpapa is on the field, after nearby party members trigger the Frozen or Melt reactions, the Pyro and Hydro RES of opponents affected by that reaction decreases by 20% for 12s. Additionally, Citlali will regain 16 Nightsoul points. Nightsoul points can be restored this way once every 8s.

passives.name: Itzpapalotl's Star Garments
_curatorNotes: These are EM scaling additions to specific abilities (Frostfall Storm: +90% EM as DMG; Ice Storm: +1200% EM as DMG), not standalone damage events. Modelled as damage effects with manual trigger because the schema lacks a 'flat damage scaling addition gated by ability id' primitive — a buff on skillFlatDmg / burstFlatDmg would over-apply (Citlali's initial Obsidian Tzitzimitl skill hit doesn't get +90% EM in gcsim's a4Dmg).
+4 Nightsoul on nearby Nightsoul Burst event: pure resource, not modelled.

↻ EFFECT RETIRED 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). passive: Itzpapalotl's Star Garments — effects[0] (damage 90% em, cryo) carried `trigger: manual` and reached no surface. gcsim: `internal/characters/citlali/asc.go:66-77` — `a4Dmg()` returns `0.9 * em` only for `frostFallAbil`, and `skill.go:161-170` adds it as `FlatDmg` on the Frostfall Storm tick; the skill's own `Obsidian Tzitzimitl DMG` (`skill.go:37`) gets nothing. Retained: A4 adds 90% of EM as flat DMG to Itzpapa's Frostfall Storm tick ONLY (gcsim `a4Dmg`, `asc.go:66-77`) — not to the skill's initial Obsidian Tzitzimitl hit, which is why `skillFlatDmg` cannot carry it; the +4 Nightsoul on a team Nightsoul Burst stays resource-only. ⚠️ This is the near-miss CONVERT. `skillFlatDmg` would print +90% EM on the always-on chip and claim it for the Tzitzimitl hit too — a named-ability scope inside a class the character has other damage in, which the brief rules a RETIRE. The honest home for a per-tick addend is `DamageEffect.flatScaling` on Itzpapa's existing summon tick (`{"stat":"em","ratio":90}`), but that reaches no surface either (a summon tick's damage draws a marker, never a number), so it buys nothing.

↻ EFFECT RETIRED 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). passive: Itzpapalotl's Star Garments — effects[1] (damage 1200% em, cryo) carried `trigger: manual` and reached no surface. gcsim: `internal/characters/citlali/asc.go:71-73` — `a4Dmg()` returns `12 * em` for `iceStormAbil`, applied as `FlatDmg` at `burst.go:53`; the burst's second instance `Spiritvessel Skull DMG` (`burst.go:55-66`) is also `AttackTagElementalBurst` and gets none. Retained: +1200% of EM as flat DMG on the burst's Ice Storm hit alone; the Spiritvessel Skulls the same burst throws are burst-tagged and do NOT receive it (`burst.go:55-66`), so `burstFlatDmg` would over-claim. ⚠️ gcsim writes `12 * em` and the kit says 1200% — the same number, stated twice; no disagreement to report. ⚠️ Both A4 effects were authored with no `ascension` gate, so any re-authoring would have had to add `{"type":"ascension","min":4}`.
passives.description:
During the Elemental Skill Dawnfrost Darkstar, Itzpapa's Frostfall Storm DMG is increased by 90% of Citlali's Elemental Mastery. During the Elemental Burst Edict of Entwined Splendor, Ice Storm DMG is increased by 1200% of Citlali's Elemental Mastery.
In addition, when nearby party members trigger Nightsoul Bursts, Citlali regains 4 Nightsoul points.

notModeled.reason: The Rotation Planner doesn't draw damage amounts, and this only raises how hard Itzpapa's Frostfall Storm and Ice Storm hit. The Rotation Planner doesn't track Nightsoul points either.

constellations.name: Radiant Blades of Centzon Mimixcoah
_curatorNotes: Stellar Blade stacks: 10 on E cast, +3 per Frozen/Melt (8s ICD), max stacks unspecified in description. Each non-Citlali N/C/P/E/Q hit consumes 1 stack and adds 200% EM as DMG. Modelled as a single 200% EM damage effect (one stack) with manual trigger; per-stack accounting + 'consumed by other characters' attribution aren't expressible.
Phlogiston consumption -45% for leap/aim/CA: out of scope (Phlogiston is a Natlan exploration mechanic).

↻ EFFECT RETIRED 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). C1 — effects[0] (damage 200% em) carried `trigger: manual` and reached no surface. gcsim: `internal/characters/citlali/cons.go:27-57` — an `OnEnemyHit` hook that fires on a NON-Citlali ACTIVE character's N/CA/Plunge/Skill/Burst hit, adds `em * 2` to that hit's `FlatDmg` and decrements `numStellarBlades`; the pool is 10 on E cast plus 3 per team Frozen/Melt on an 8s ICD (`asc.go:32-38`). Retained: a per-hit flat-DMG add-on to SOMEBODY ELSE's hit, drawn from a 10-stack pool (+3 per team Frozen/Melt, 8s ICD, `cons.go:45-56` + `asc.go:35-37`); one stack is spent per qualifying hit, which is a consumption our `consumeStacks` cannot dispatch (it is `onCast`-only) — and the bonus covers all five attack classes, for which there is no single FlatDmg stat. ⚠️ The five-effect shape (`normalFlatDmg`/`chargeFlatDmg`/`plungeFlatDmg`/`skillFlatDmg`/`burstFlatDmg` on `target: 'active'`, armed for Itzpapa's life) is expressible and is a serious over-claim: it would print +200% EM on EVERY qualifying hit for 20s where the game allows 10 hits plus reaction top-ups. `perStack` is the wrong shape too — it multiplies one hit's bonus by the stack count, where the mechanic spends one stack per hit.
constellations.description:
When she uses the Elemental Skill Dawnfrost Darkstar, Citlali gains the "Opalstar Vestments" effect until Itzpapa leaves the field. During this time, she will obtain 10 stacks of Stellar Blade. When a nearby active character other than Citlali deals DMG using Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks, or Elemental Skills and Bursts, 1 stack of Stellar Blade will be consumed to increase the DMG dealt by 200% of Citlali's Elemental Mastery.
After nearby party members trigger Frozen or Melt, Citlali will gain another 3 stacks of Stellar Blade. This effect can trigger once every 8s.

constellations.name: Heart Devourer's Travail
_curatorNotes: Three mechanics: (1) +125 EM Citlali (always-on with C2); (2) +250 EM for shielded teammates (or Itzpapa-followed) — 'Itzpapa following them' part not modellable, only the shielded-state half is gated; (3) A1 enhancement: additional -20% Pyro/Hydro shred (stacks with A1's base -20% for total -40%), modelled as separate resShred entries gated on C2.
Opal Shield extension to nearby active char on E cast: not modelled — would require 'opens shield state on teammate' primitive.
constellations.description:
Citlali gains 125 Elemental Mastery, and other characters shielded by her Opal Shield, or who have Itzpapa following them, gain 250 Elemental Mastery.
Additionally, when the Elemental Skill Dawnfrost Darkstar is used, nearby active characters will also be granted an Opal Shield.

Also, the Ascension Talent "Mamaloaco's Frigid Rain" has its effects enhanced:
While Itzpapa is on the field, after nearby party members trigger Frozen or Melt, the opponent(s) affected by this reaction will have their Pyro and Hydro RES additionally decreased by 20% for 12s. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Mamaloaco's Frigid Rain" to gain access to the above effect.

constellations.description: While the Elemental Skill Dawnfrost Darkstar is active, when Itzpapa's Frostfall Storm hits opponents, an additional Obsidian Spiritvessel Skull will be summoned. When a Spiritvessel Skull summoned this way explodes, it deals 1800% of Citlali's Elemental Mastery as Nightsoul-aligned AoE Cryo DMG and restores 16 Nightsoul points and 8 Energy for Citlali. This effect can trigger once every 8s. This DMG is not considered Elemental Burst DMG.

constellations.name: Teoiztac's Secret Pact
_curatorNotes: Cifra of the Secret Law: Citlali earns up to 40 stacks (1 per Nightsoul point Itzpapa consumes). Each stack grants team +1.5% Pyro/Hydro DMG and Citlali +2.5% all DMG. Stack accumulation requires Nightsoul resource tracking; not modelled per the constitution. Itzpapa's Opal Fire 'always active' override also not modelled (resource gating). Removed prior placeholder hydroDmgBonus 2.5% effect that was modelling one stack with the wrong stat target.
constellations.description:
After being summoned with the Elemental Skill Dawnfrost Darkstar, Itzpapa will always be in the Opal Fire state, and when Nightsoul points are exhausted, this state will not end.
Additionally, when Dawnfrost Darkstar is used, Itzpapa will consume all Nightsoul points, and while it is on the field, it will continuously consume Nightsoul points. Each Nightsoul point consumed in this way will grant Citlali 1 "Cifra of the Secret Law" point.
A maximum of 40 such points can be gained, and each point Citlali possesses will grant all nearby party members a 1.5% Pyro and Hydro DMG Bonus, and increase the DMG Citlali deals by 2.5%.
When Itzpapa leaves the field, or upon using Citlali's Elemental Skill again, all "Cifra of the Secret Law" points she has will be removed.

notModeled.reason: The Rotation Planner doesn't track Nightsoul points, and the Cifra of the Secret Law behind this Pyro and Hydro DMG Bonus builds from the points Itzpapa consumes.
